source_problem: The declared Set(BookCopy) result and reservation-to-copy projection need explicit duplicate handling when multiple Reserve objects refer to the same BookCopy.
approved_preconditions: The reservation collection can be resolved.
approved_postconditions: Return the BookCopy objects linked to the selected user's reservation records.
Each BookCopy object appears once even when multiple reservation records refer to it.
Different BookCopy objects remain separate even when their attribute values are equal.
Do not restrict the query to open reservations; the original operation has no reservation-closed filter.
fixture_identity_note: copy_key and in_selected_user_reservations describe object identities and membership in the selected user's ReservedBook association, not additional model attributes. is_closed varies to verify the absence of an added eligibility filter.
correction_scope: Clarify identity-based Set projection from the selected user's existing reservation collection. Preserve uid, the existing source preconditions and Set(BookCopy). Add no open-reservation filter, model field, inverse update or global state-frame condition.
